TARGET_DEPENDENT_TIE_BREAKS.reason: ts_chatterjee_xi must not sort tied-X rows by the response y

UNKNOWN_TO_FALSE_PATTERN_BUGS.reason: a NaN pattern input must not collapse into a confirmed False / 0

INTRADAY_OBSERVED_ROW_AS_CLOCK_BUGS.reason: intraday time positions must use official slot ordinals, not observed-row indices

INTRADAY_INFERRED_BAR_WIDTH_FROM_OBSERVE.reason: bar width must come from a declared contract, never observed deltas

INTRADAY_UNDETECTED_PHYSICAL_GAPS.reason: physically absent minutes must be explicit missing slots, never invisible NaN

SESSION_ENDPOINT_SUBSTITUTION_BUGS.reason: segment / lunch-gap endpoints must be exact official minutes by default

UNDECLARED_UNBOUNDED_STATE.reason: ffill / carried state / pivot age must be bounded by an explicit lookback

UNDERDECLARED_NESTED_HISTORY.reason: nested window history must be declared as a sum, not max

DEFAULT_GUARANTEED_INFEASIBLE_OPERATORS.reason: registered defaults must be runtime-feasible (not guaranteed raise / all-NaN)

UNDEFINED_ESTIMATOR_MAPPED_TO_NORMAL_ZER.reason: an undefined estimator (e.g. positive Roll covariance) must be NaN, never 0

NUMERIC_CANCELLATION_BLOCKERS.reason: sum(x²)-sum(x)²/n style SSE must be recentered (no catastrophic cancellation)

PRELOG_OVERFLOW_UNDERFLOW_BLOCKERS.reason: log-domain computation must not materialise abs(λ)² / abs(b)²

SIGNED_PROBABILITY_MISLABELED_AS_PROBABI.reason: conditional-probability differences must be declared signed, never [0,1] probability

DIMENSIONALLY_INVALID_OPERATOR_MODES.reason: directional-change scale units must be mode-fixed (PriceDistance vs DimensionlessVol)

INVALID_COMPOSITION_SCHEMAS.reason: composition schemas must be genuine part-whole; financial_statement flow fields are rejected

SURROGATE_MISSING_TOPOLOGY_DRIFT.reason: TE surrogates must fix the NaN mask and rearrange only finite positions

PCA_UNNECESSARY_RANK_REJECTION.reason: PCA residual must require rank >= k (not k+1)

R26_UNREVIEWED_STATIC_HAZARD_HITS.reason: every static hazard hit must be classified (remaining_unreviewed == 0)
